Add a company catalog for this request: `$ARGUMENTS`. Read section 8 of
`.claude/skills/regulatory-catalogs/SKILL.md` first. Every write goes through
`node .claude/scripts/catalogs/add-company-catalog.mjs`; never create or edit `company-profile/*/catalogs/` or
`company-profile/*/regulators.json` with file tools.

1. **Which company.** The first argument is the company id. If it is missing or `company-profile/<company_id>/` does
   not exist, ask (or suggest `/seed-company`) and stop. Work on that one company only: never read, copy or cite
   another company's catalogs.

2. **What is already there.** `node .claude/scripts/catalogs/company.mjs list <company_id>` shows the company's own
   catalogs and sources. If the source already has a catalog, the change replaces it (`--force`): say so first.

3. **Build the spec** from what the person gives you (the document, or its sections pasted into the chat):
   - `catalog.id`: a short lower-case slug for the source (`infosec-policy`, `customer-a-schedule`); `title`;
     `sourceType` (`internal-policy`, `customer-contract`, `sector-circular`, `industry-standard`,
     `audit-commitment`, `other`); `version`; `sourceUrl` when it has one, otherwise `sourceRef` (where the document
     is kept); `effectiveFrom` when known.
   - `catalog.regulator`: a shared regulator (`SEBI`, `RBI`, ...) for a circular, otherwise one of the company's
     sources, added under `sources` (`{ "id": "board", "name": "Board of directors", "type": "internal" }`, a
     customer is `type: "customer"`). Name a customer only as the person names it.
   - `groups[].controls[]`: one control per obligation, in the shared control shape: `id` as the document numbers
     it (or a short one you make up, unique in the catalog), `title`, `prose` (the requirement, verbatim or a
     faithful paraphrase), `mandatory`, `defaultSeverity` for mandatory controls (ask when the document does not make
     it clear), `cadence`, `slaDays` only when the document states a deadline, `evidenceExpected`, `mappings` to the
     equivalent shared controls you are sure of (`{regulator, instrument, controlId}` from the shared catalogs), and
     `probeWorkflows` that can evidence it.
   - Never put credentials, keys or personal data in the spec.

4. **Check, then write.** Pipe the spec to `node .claude/scripts/catalogs/add-company-catalog.mjs - --dry-run` and
   show the person the controls in a short table (id, title, severity, mappings). Write only after they agree:
   the same command without `--dry-run` (add `--force` only to replace a catalog they asked to replace). Exit 2
   means the writer refused: report its message, fix the spec and try again; never work around it.

5. Say what was written (the files the writer printed) and that `/refresh-soc <company_id>` adds the new controls
   to the company's ledger; only that company's audits use them.
